capture: For every published direction, per expressed class and for the structural classes required and type, the number of class-targeted mutants of the recorded native observations that the published variants refuse with the targeted keyword at the targeted instance path (crossField: with a relation keyword, including a multi-member not, at the relation's object; required: a present required member deleted, refused at its object; type: a value of an excluded JSON type; default: positive omission checks), and the SHA-256 of their sorted identities observation|variant|keyword|instancePath|keyword value (required: the deleted member; type: the declared and the replacement types). scripts/schema-completeness.test.mjs recomputes both; a change means an observed constraint, or an observation value (an embedded snapshot or a referenced oracle-corpus row), was added, removed or changed and must be re-recorded deliberately.
nonClaims: The corpus covers only schema locations the recorded observations reach; it does not enumerate every published constraint.
